Contract CoCoMEOrderProducts::makeNewOrder(orderid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		order: OrderProduct = OrderProduct.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = orderID)
	precondition:
		OrderProduct.allInstance()->excludes(order)
	postcondition:
		order.oclIsNew() and
		OrderProduct.allInstance()->includes(order) and
		order.OrderStatus = OrderStatus::NEW and
		order.Id = orderID and
		order.Time = now() and
		result = order
}
